description: Proposed, missing, deliberately separated and speculative relations shown outside the proven trail graph. This is not discovery or runtime connection evidence.

items.reason: One public-safe snapshot might be both the map's output and a verifier's input; separate source identity and receiver pickup still matter.
items.next_test: Have an independent local verifier consume the exact snapshot bytes, then compare the expected node and relation counts.

items.reason: A native X2/CoBar/CoOrb receiver with current startup, currentness and exact readproof has not been qualified for this map.
items.next_test: On an authorized device, verify the active receiver and one exact-object pickup before asserting native integration.

items.reason: Public graph views must not automatically copy private state to Gmail, CoVIA, sites or undiscovered nodes; separation is intentional until an authorized route exists.
items.next_test: Attempt a synthetic unauthorized dispatch and prove zero outbound messages or receiver-state promotions.

items.reason: A virtual-session descriptor is not proof that Claude, Pi or local Ollama can execute and recover the same authorized work packet.
items.next_test: Replay one consented public packet using a deterministic baseline and one actual available model, retaining latency and recovery receipts.

items.reason: A predicted destination, highlighted trail, animation or copied pointer cannot establish that a remote receiver applied the intended effect.
items.next_test: Inject a forged receiver ACK into the local fixture and verify that promotion is refused without independent receiver readproof.

items.reason: A further useful computation or representation substrate is possible, but no specific new substrate or endpoint has been observed and qualified.
items.next_test: Write down one finite falsifiable candidate and test for its existence with permission; record a negative search outcome explicitly.

items.reason: Spiritual or symbolic interpretations may inspire design and reflection but are not evidence of a nonmaterial communications channel.
items.next_test: Specify the interpretation and any separate physical prediction before presenting it as an empirical claim.

items.reason: Extraterrestrial intelligence is an empirical research question; no extraterrestrial interface or conversation is observed in this prototype.
items.next_test: Choose an existing publicly verifiable research hypothesis, prediction and evidence threshold before ranking resources.

items.reason: G_d requires explicit units, definitions and discriminating tests before it can support resource selection or scientific conclusions.
items.next_test: Specify a reproducible mathematical definition and seek a counterexample against simpler distance measures.
